answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks 50 POA in escrow, its inviter on the graph, so the referral chain trails behind like a comet's tail. Peers may dispute a cluster; confirmed fakes slash the whole cluster, referrer included, no velvet cushion softening the blow. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA vs a 30,000 POA pool, each slash leaving a plume of smoke. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
